customManagers.description: tools/toolchain.versions GO_VERSION, which verify.sh's pins leg compares against go.work; no built-in manager reads it.

packageRules.description: Majors are never unattended: the top-level automerge covers patch and minor only.
Go toolchain (go.mod and go.work directives, toolchain.versions, golang builder images) in one PR, never automerged. Last so it overrides the gomod and dockerfile groups above.

Hold Go versions 14 days. CI runs on the Go baked into the forgejo-runner-ubuntu image with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so a go directive newer than that image fails every Go job. k3s opens its runner-Go PR after 3 days; the 11-day gap is for rebuilding and rolling the image. A heuristic, not a guarantee: check `go version` in a recent CI run before merging. golang builder images are not held: Docker builds bring their own Go.
